title: Sign on to an operator session
description: Authenticate an operator to MERIDIAN CORE and verify the session reached the main menu.
goal: On the MERIDIAN CORE sign-on screen, enter the supplied Operator ID and Password. Select the supplied Branch value. Press Sign On. Verify that the MAIN MENU is displayed and read the MAIN MENU heading as session_status.

outputs.name: session_status
outputs.description: MAIN MENU when an authenticated operator session is active.
